runtime_reachability_audit.method: Exhaustive grep of every call to assetLibrary.load(domain, id) and assetUrl(domain, id) across src/. Only 2 call sites exist in the entire codebase: src/render/FlightScene.ts:144 (domain 'world', id from ACTIVE_REGION_ASSETS) and src/render/FlightScene.ts:158 (domain 'airframe', id from FRAME_ASSET_IDS).

world_domain.note: 3 world GLBs exist on disk but are not placed in any of the 8 regions' ACTIVE_REGION_ASSETS arrays in src/render/assetManifest.ts.

airframe_domain.referenced_ids: hero_ultralight (frame_zero, special-cased path outside airframes/), l1_01 (frame_yardbird), a2_01 (frame_trailblazer), g3_01 (frame_bush_king) -- FRAME_ASSET_IDS (src/render/assetManifest.ts) now covers every FrameDefinition in src/content/parts.ts#FRAMES, selectable via BuilderScreen's frame selector and state/profileStore.ts#selectFrame

upgrade_domain.note: assetUrl() supports building an 'upgrade' path but grep found zero call sites anywhere in src/ that invoke assetLibrary.load('upgrade', ...).

micro_domain.note: Same as upgrade: type-level support exists (assetManifest.ts case 'micro'), zero call sites.

runtime_reachability_audit.headline_finding: 27 of 361 GLB files (about 7.5%) are reachable from the running game as of the frame-selector fix (src/ui/screens/BuilderScreen.tsx, src/state/profileStore.ts#selectFrame, src/render/assetManifest.ts#FRAME_ASSET_IDS). The other 334 are exported, licensed, and shipped inert in public/ -- present in the production bundle's static asset folder but never fetched by any code path.

distinct_but_related_system.name: worldVisualIdentity.ts landmark system
distinct_but_related_system.description: src/render/worldVisualIdentity.ts assigns one LandmarkKind (silos/headframe/rock-gateway/lookout/lighthouse/stacks/radio-mast) per terrain family, rendered via a glyph + label (data structure, not confirmed to be a 3D model reference) -- this is a separate, smaller, and apparently fully-wired data-driven system, distinct from the orphaned GLB library above. Included here so the two are not conflated: the landmark *assignment* logic is implemented and tested (worldVisualIdentity.test.ts), even though most of the *asset library* it could theoretically draw from is unused.

unknowns: Whether the 333 unreferenced GLBs represent (a) content genuinely planned for later tiers/regions and simply not yet wired, (b) abandoned work from an earlier version of the roster generator, or (c) intentionally pre-exported for a future patch. No commit message, doc, or code comment in this repo states which. Flagged rather than guessed -- see TASK_GRAPH.json ASSET-01.
